requirement: A request in a Latin language the reading does not know (Norwegian, Danish, Swedish, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese) is never read as Dutch and so never makes the agent reply in Dutch; the agent is shown every class that lays an element out (a menu's pill class) and told to look for a layout in the settings of the record that prints it

oracle.ref: PR #1602 (fix); fix evidence: 22/10/2026, a real imported Joomla site (customer in Norway): six requests for a horizontal menu answered 'done' with no change on the page (the menu module carried the class nav-pills), and the customer reported the site had switched to Dutch. Measured on the unchanged code: 18 of 75 (Norwegian 6 of 11, Danish 5 of 8, Swedish 5 of 8, Italian 2 of 8) sentences of 12 other languages read as Dutch. After: 0 of 75.
oracle.invariant: S1: no sentence of the 75 reads as 'nl'; the four Dutch sentences still read 'nl'; Vietnamese is unchanged. S2: the agent is told <ul.mod-menu.mod-list.nav.nav-pills>, not <ul.mod-menu.mod-list>; no name is longer than 79 characters. S3: the sentence is present for wordpress, joomla and emdash with the designer mode and absent for a mode that cannot change a look.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
